Block1: Root's Hollow Make expertise local, embodied, and respected. A settlement whose alchemists brave Sablewood and the Lucent River for healing water, roots, herbs, and careful local knowledge. Root's Hollow makes healing labor visible. The alchemists here read Sablewood for a living. They know what the river heals and what it costs to fetch it. Root's Hollow makes healing labor visible. Every remedy here was paid for by someone going out into the wood. That debt of risk colors how freely they share. pages/entities/root-s-hollow.html

Block2: Low workrooms nestle among roots with drying herbs and blue-glass bottles. Every bench has a clean side and a dangerous side. Some labels are drawn by shape for people who cannot risk misreading in low light. River water is stored away from open flame. Detail Sharp herbs, mineral water, beeswax, damp root, and alcohol bite. Detail Root walls are cool; bottle glass tingles where Lucent water was stored. Block4: The place changes even if the PCs stand still. Local people, creatures, weather, signage, and ward behavior all keep moving around the scene. Mixing substances casually can waste or harm. Good medicine is scarce enough to create pressure. Outsiders may treat expertise as supply. A bottle clouds when the Keystone is named. An herb bundle dries to ash in a heartbeat. Let the place be funny through overconfident signage, awkward forms, stubborn local habits, and magic that refuses corporate language.
